title: Chapter 127: Who Should Cut Off The Great Head?
content:
Chapter 127: Who Should Cut Off The Great Head?

Saving lives is like putting out fires, and there is no room for hesitation for a moment. In desperation, Heifu had to go into battle himself and use the battlefield rescue skills he had learned in school in his previous life but had almost forgotten about to give first aid to the East Gate Leopard.

Blood is an important substance for maintaining life. When the body is injured several times like the East Gate Leopard, the blood vessels are damaged, which can lead to acute bleeding and a large amount of bleeding. If the bleeding is not stopped in time, it will often cause shock, cardiac arrest, and eventually death.

Now, Dongmen Leopard has fainted from shock and is unconscious, so the first thing Heifu has to do is to stop his bleeding!

Everyone came over one after another and helped to remove Dongmen Leopard's armor that was in the way. Heifu discovered that the main wound on his leg was the one where he was cut open by Ge, which damaged the artery and caused blood to continuously leak out. Fortunately, there were no arrow clusters, wood chips or other foreign matter left in the wound.

What does Heifu have on hand? Iodine? Disinfectant water? Not at all.

Rubber tourniquet? It was even more impossible. Hei Fu could only use local materials, ask everyone to take off their belts, and then use some unfamiliar techniques to start bandaging the East Gate Leopard.

Everyone's belt is either a rough cloth belt or just a hemp rope. In later generations, the use of these materials to stop bleeding was limited to temporary use in emergencies where a tourniquet was not available. Because fabric rope is different from rubber and has no elasticity, it is difficult to truly stop bleeding. If it is tied too tightly, it may even cause limb damage and ischemic necrosis!

But I can't control that much at this time. If the bleeding can be stopped, everything will be easy. Just save Dongmen Bao's life first and let him live in the military camp and hand it over to a professional doctor.

"The location of the tourniquet must be correct. The lower limbs should be in the middle and upper part of the thigh. There must be padding and appropriate tightness...the padding..."

Heifu muttered these forgotten tips. He looked left and right and saw that everyone's clothes were very dirty and stained with blood. The only clean thing was the Wei flag that was torn down from the arrow tower. It's quite new.

Heifu's eyes suddenly lit up: "Go and get the Wei people's flag!"

There was a crisp sound of tearing silk, and the crimson flag of the Wei State made of silk, with a picture of an auspicious beast showing teeth and claws on it, was torn into pieces at this moment, becoming the padding for the middle and upper thighs of the East Gate Leopard.

"The bandage should be appropriately tight, and when tying knots, avoid wounds and areas that are not suitable for compression..."

Immediately, Heifu used a belt to put pressure on the padding, wrap it around the leg, pull both ends forward tightly, and tie a slip knot.

"shaft!"

As he shouted, Xiao Tao immediately picked up a long arrow on the ground, removed the feathers and clusters, and handed it to Heifu.

Heifu used the arrow shaft as a twisting rod, inserted it into the outer ring of the belt, lifted the glue stick and twisted it tightly, and inserted the other end of the twisted rod into the small circle of the slipknot to fix it...

At this point, the main wound on Dongmen Leopard's leg has been treated.

After finishing all this in one go, seeing that the bleeding on Dongmen Leopard's leg had stopped, Heifu wiped the sweat from his forehead. Fortunately, at this life-saving moment, he actually memorized most of the battlefield first aid operations without missing a beat.

Afterwards, Heifu used the torn silk strips from the Wei flag as bandages to bandage Dongmen Leopard's other wounds of various sizes. In some places, it is wrapped with a triangle bandage, and in other places, it is wrapped with a spiral bandage.

Not long after, Dongmen Leopard's body was covered with crimson flag stripes. At first glance, it looked like the remains of a martyr wrapped in flags...

"Bah!" Heifu quickly drove away this unlucky thought. He firmly believed that Dongmen Bao was a tough man and would definitely not die.

At this time, the west city gate had been opened. Heifu immediately called Ji Ying and a few others to carry a door panel used to fill gullies during the siege. He carefully placed the east gate leopard on it and hurriedly carried it towards the military camp.

They gradually drifted away, but Heifu still couldn't let go of his hanging heart.

After the bandaging was completed, Bu Cheng tested Dongmen Leopard's pulse. Although it was weak, it was still stable. He finally survived, but what Heifu was most worried about was the subsequent wound infection.

There is no disinfection during the entire bandaging process, and the bandaging cloth used cannot be guaranteed to be clean. So next, the life and death of the Dongmen Leopard...

"It just depends on whether Da Siming or Young Siming accepts him!"

After saying that, Hei Fu turned his head and stopped thinking about the matter. When he returned to the city, he saw that there were still some Wei flags left, so he did his best to help the man whose palm was shot by an arrow to climb to Tuntun first. The chief was also bandaged.

"Thank you."

The village chief finally opened his eyes, looked at the silk strip tied with a figure eight knot in his hand, and nodded to Mr. Hei, his eyes full of gratitude.

"My name is Huaimu, and everyone in the village is from Jingling County, Nanjun."

"Jingling and Anlu are only two days away. You and I are fellow villagers. We can help you so much, so there is no need to say thank you."

Heifu smiled, and when he turned around, he found that not only Bu Cheng, Li Xian, Gong Ao, Xiao Tao and others from his own village, but also the remaining ten or so people from Xiandeng Village were looking at him with admiration. he.

“I didn’t know that the village chief knew how to heal golden sores!”

…

Heifu couldn't explain why he did it, so he just pretended to be mysterious. In the next moment, he acted as a medical soldier again, bandaging the wounds of several people who were not seriously injured. It is a pity that those who had broken hands and were seriously injured with swords in their chests and abdomens in Xiandentun died long ago before the battle was over.

At this moment, the west of the city was completely occupied by the Qin people. A large number of Qin soldiers, as many as hundreds, began to march towards the south of the city and other places to clear out the remaining enemies in the city who were stubbornly resisting.

The military judge also climbed to the top of the city and began to count the number of beheadings during the siege.

You must know that the people of Qin made the first contribution. For this reason, they "donated their armor and clothing to the enemy, carried heads on their left, and carried prisoners on their right." This was very terrifying in the eyes of the people of the Six Kingdoms.

But in fact, during the battle, Qin soldiers would not squat down, cut off their heads and tie them to their belts every time they killed someone. For more than a hundred years, the Qin army has formed a rule that beheadings must be done after the battle, and must be done under the eyes of military judges, so that the battle will not be overturned because the soldiers are busy fighting for the heads. reverse.

"On the west side of Waihuang City, we beheaded the enemy forty-two times in total."

The military judge held two large wooden boards, one of which was used to record deserters and judge their crimes. One piece records the number of beheadings and is used to discuss merit. Speaking of which, although the casualties caused by the Qin army's attack on the city were relatively large, not many enemies were killed on the spot. These forty-two heads had to be divided among several villages according to the amount of siege effort.

The people who ascended the camp first and got ten heads so that they could reach the "Prosperity Theory" and those who died in battle could have titles, naturally no one had any objections.

Heifu's village put in a lot of effort, and Dongmen Leopard defended the battlements with one enemy. So their village claimed 12 heads. Five people in their village died in the battle, and now the number of gains exceeded the number of battle losses. At least Heifu had escaped the danger of being held accountable.

The two villages that defeated Zhang Caishi and the archers each claimed five heads. This was what they deserved, especially those who defeated Zhang Caishi. They shot more than this number of Wei people to death.

In addition, the gully-filling and bamboo-ladder-carrying tuns each received level 5. They also suffered a lot of casualties when they were under the city. They couldn't be punished for not making any gains.

Generally speaking, this kind of military law officials allocate heads to each village according to their combat contributions, which is more fair than whoever cuts off the head first.

However, with such a distribution, everyone could not be happy. Because except for the special method of calculating the head level of the first-to-den villages, everyone from the village commander to the soldiers can be promoted to one level. The other several villages must be calculated according to the military nobility law.

"If you get more than thirty-three poems, you will be awarded a rank of one rank by the generals and the commander of the village."

Calculated in this way, a hundred people need to behead thirty-three heads to be considered a Ying Lun. For fifty people, at least half must be beheaded, and 17 heads are needed to be considered a Ying Lun.

Right now, Heifu's village has only been allocated 12 heads...

This also means that although his soldiers, such as Dongmen Leopard, can be promoted to nobility through beheading. However, as the commander of the village, Heifu was unable to achieve the profit theory and achieve "collective merit".

After risking his life and fighting for so long, Heifu was naturally unwilling to get nothing, so after a short rest and letting the wounded stay, Heifu took the remaining forty people and began to march towards the city.

They must chase the dead and kill them until they have enough beheadings!

…

As the Qin army ascended to the city, Waihuang ordered Zhang Er's plan to "resist for a while and then run away" in vain. He had to lead everyone in the city to retreat to the north of the city. In addition to county soldiers and retainers, he was followed by There are many strong men in the city, and there are probably more than a thousand people.

The young man with thick beard who ran away in front of Hei Fu might have really run to Zhang Er at this moment and left with him, right? Unfortunately, Hei Fu was not familiar with Zhang Er. He only felt that he had heard the name in his previous life, but could not recall his achievements. He was probably just a minor celebrity in the late Qin, Chu and Han Dynasties.

So he couldn't even guess that the bearded young knight was actually the great Emperor Gao of the Han Dynasty in history...

Considering that the number of people attacking the city was small, he was afraid that if the people in the city had no way to escape, they would fight against trapped beasts, so Yang Xiong did not besiege the city to death, but surrounded three palaces. This made Zhang Er lead Many people fled from the north of the city.

But some did not run away. Some light knights were trapped by the Qin army pouring into the city. After finding that they could not escape, they threw down their weapons and prepared to surrender.

However, they were surprised to find that the red-eyed Qin people had no intention of stopping at all. They still rushed forward excitedly and stabbed the ranger to death with a spear. Then, under the assignment of the village chief, someone was specially responsible for squatting. Come down and cut off people's heads...

This is the Qin army's fighting method determined by military merit. Even if the battle is over, as long as each camp has not reached the "surplus theory", Qin soldiers will continue to kill regardless of whether the other party intends to surrender.

In this regard, the general is also happy to see its success and will not stop it. Because in a siege battle, an army of tens of thousands of people must be beheaded at level 8,000 before the general can be upgraded, and an army of tens of thousands of people must be beheaded at level 800. Yang Xiong is calculating carefully in his mind. When he has enough beheaded, , he would let the Qin army seal the sword.

The remaining light warriors in the city, Ding Zhuang, realized that they would still die if they surrendered. The Qin people seemed to be more interested in their good heads than in the prisoners, so they continued to flee in a hurry. Qin soldiers were chasing them in the alleys everywhere!

After this battle, in the hearts of Waihuang Qingxia and civilian husbands, there was only one comment left on the fanatical Qin army who was keen on beheading people.

"A true tiger and wolf!"

Heifu's village was also among them. They had no choice but to continue fighting for the remaining five heads, even if they were exhausted.

In an alley, Heifu and Li Xian caught up with a ranger. Hei Fu raised his crossbow and shot the man, while Li Xian went over and stabbed the man to death!

"Now you have been beheaded." Heifu smiled at Li Xian and asked him to cut off the dead man's neck.

"I can finally be promoted to a sergeant."

Li Xian was so excited that he almost cried. Hei Fu had already said that within the village, the allocation of heads would be based on killing the enemy. For example, for the East Gate Leopard, Heifu calculated two levels for him, so that this guy could upgrade to two levels at once and be worthy of his death battle.

At this time, the soldiers also gathered from all the lanes and handed over their beheaded heads. Not long after, the hair from the four heads was tied together and placed in front of Hei Fu, looking very scary.

"Captain, only...only level four."

Xiao Tao was a little ashamed. Although they had been chasing the remaining enemies for half an hour, they only got four beheadings, which was still not up to the standard, so he felt very sorry for the village commander.

But Heifu didn't blame everyone. The entire Waihuang County had been captured by the Qin army. The battle was coming to an end. The enemy was dead and it was difficult to make any further gains.

At this time, Li Xian had an idea. He stared hard at a house next to Li Lu, and then kicked the door open. He saw an old man with gray hair from Wei and a man in his ten years old inside. The little boy looked at the Qin people who broke through the door with horror in his eyes!

"Captain, why don't we..." Li Xian turned around with a fierce look on his face!

"no!"

Of course Heifu knew what Li Xian planned to do, but he flatly rejected him.

"But the chief of the village is only one head away from being successful!" Everyone began to persuade Heifu. After experiencing a fight and losing brother Paoze, they all hated the Wei people.

At this time, the old man inside also realized the plans of these Qin people, and quickly asked his grandson to hide behind him. He bowed his head towards the door and begged for mercy in a Wei accent.

"Maybe this old man will go to the city to resist, or maybe this young man will become a rebellious ranger in a few years!"

Li Xian pointed at the two men with a fierce look on his face: "Kill them, kill any one of them, and you can become the commander of the village!"

Hei Fu looked at the two people in the room. The old man kept kowtowing heavily, with tears streaming down his face. Hei Fu could understand a little of the Wei dialect in his mouth. He probably wanted to kill him and spare his grandson. The little boy, only eleven or twelve years old, was leaning against the wall, trembling with fear.

"I've made up my mind!"

Heifu drove everyone out of the house, bowed to the frightened Wei man, and closed the door.

He has his own bottom line.

Killing the enemy in battle, chasing people north, and beheading them. Although he could not say that he liked this kind of life, he could accept it. Even killing prisoners, Heifu could hold his nose and do it. After all, the prisoners had resisted the Qin Dynasty. The army even killed their robes.

But killing good people and taking credit for their crimes, and using the heads of innocent people to cushion their own losses, is what Heifu hates so much.

In the eyes of Qin people, this old man and young man are foreigners. But in Heifu's view, we are all Chinese people, so how can we distinguish between Qin and Wei? Before joining the army, his subordinates also lived the same hard but peaceful life in their respective hometowns.

Although there are no innocent people in war, if Heifu raises his butcher knife to the defenseless people and chops off their heads for the sake of his promotion today...

Then, it is not far away that one day he will turn into a villain with no bottom line, issue orders to massacre the people in the city, and indulge his subordinates in rape and robbery!

Heifu would rather be promoted to a noble title later than be completely assimilated into this chaotic era and become something he hates!

Li Xian and others were a little confused about the village chief's decision, and they all felt sorry for him, but at this moment, outside the village, Bu Cheng ran over panting.

"Captain, something serious has happened!"

He was acting together with Gong Ao, but now he came back alone. Hef felt bad and asked, "What happened?"

Bu Cheng said anxiously: "Gong Ao was fighting for his head with someone from another village! He was arrested by the military magistrate!"

…
